title: Coupled reaction channels calculations in nuclear physics

raw_affiliation_strings: Department of Engineering Mathematics, Bristol University, Bristol, BS8 1TR, UK
Department of Engineering Mathematics, Bristol University, Bristol BS8 1TR, UK

abstract: This paper describes the components and methods of a comprehensive code for coupled reaction channels calculations in nuclear physics. Procedures are described which are common to the modelling of reactions induced by light and medium-mass ions, and which are sufficient to calculate the effects of successive processes to any order.
